fields.htmlDescription: Daniel Gleim is a computer science student and works as a content creator for Search Guard.
fields.shortDescription: Daniel Gleim is a Computer Science student and works as a Technical Content Creator for Search Guard.
fields.biography: Daniel has been with us since November 2024. He started his time as a Technical Content Creator alongside his studies and will complete his Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at the Leibniz University in Hannover this year.

fields.htmlDescription: Verity is the driving force behind content at Search Guard, ensuring engaging, insightful, and high-quality narratives that highlight innovation, leadership, and technology.
fields.shortDescription: Verity is the driving force behind content at Search Guard, ensuring engaging, insightful, and high-quality narratives that highlight innovation, leadership, and technology.
fields.biography:
Verity is a skilled content strategist and writer with a passion for translating complex topics into compelling, accessible stories. With expertise in SEO, social media, and content marketing, Verity crafts impactful messaging that aligns with Search Guard’s mission and resonates with its audience.

Working alongside CMO Anja Glauch, Verity plays a crucial role in content direction, brand storytelling, and thought leadership initiatives. Whether developing long-form articles, social media strategies, or integrated marketing campaigns, Verity ensures that every piece of content adds value and strengthens Search Guard’s presence in the tech space.

Beyond content creation, Verity is always exploring the latest trends in digital marketing, AI-driven content, and audience engagement strategies, continuously refining approaches to deliver meaningful and results-driven storytelling.

fields.htmlDescription: Jochen Kressin is a Serial Entrepreneur and the Co-Founder of Search Guard, Eliatra and go-ffwd.
fields.shortDescription: Jochen Kressin is the Founder and CEO of Search Guard and Eliatra. Search Guard is one of the first security plugins for Elasticsearch and Kibana, so he has year-long experience providing security solutions for this ecosystem. With the advent of ODFE and finally OpenSearch, Jochen Co-founded Eliatra. Eliatra specializes in support, services, products and solutions for OpenSearch and is an official partner and contributor to the project.
fields.biography:
I am a seasoned CTO, IT architect, and serial entrepreneur with over 18 years of experience in leading high-performance, multi-national teams and driving innovative IT solutions across diverse industries. My expertise spans distributed systems, high-traffic platforms, and open-source technologies, with a strong emphasis on security, scalability, and business alignment.

As Co-Founder and Director at Eliatra, Co-Founder & CEO at go-ffwd GmbH, and CEO & CTO of Search Guard, I’ve led organizations specializing in search analytics, cybersecurity, and technological innovation. My entrepreneurial ventures include founding Symlink GmbH and contributing as an interim CTO at Künstlerfreunde GbR and ShopReader UG, where I drove technological strategy and product development.

Earlier in my career, I held leadership roles at StayFriends GmbH as Director of New Business and Principal IT Architect, and served as a Software Architect at artnology GmbH, delivering large-scale software systems. My background also includes experience as a J2EE Consultant and Developer of server-side solutions.

Academically, I hold an MBA in Information Technology from the University of Potsdam and a Dipl.-Ing. in Computer Science from FH Offenburg. 

Passionate about disruptive technologies, digital innovation, and scalable architectures, I am driven to bridge the gap between technical excellence and strategic business goals. I thrive in environments where technology meets entrepreneurship, and I am always eager to collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what's possible in the digital landscape.

Let’s connect to discuss technology, innovation, or future collaborations!

fields.htmlDescription: Anja Glauch is the Chief Marketing Officer with over two decades of experience in SEO, social media, and integrated marketing communications.
fields.shortDescription: Anja Glauch is the Chief Marketing Officer with over two decades of experience in SEO, social media, and integrated marketing communications.
fields.biography:
Anja Glauch is a seasoned marketing professional with extensive expertise in digital strategy. She spent seven years leading the SEO & Social team at IG Group in London, where she centralized organic search strategies, managed content direction, and improved search engine visibility. Prior to IG Group, Anja held a strategic role at Groupon, establishing a growth channel and collaborating with global leadership to enhance performance. 

As CMO, Anja oversees SEO, advertisements, campaign planning, event planning, and social media management and so much more. Her leadership skills and digital marketing acumen are instrumental in driving our marketing initiatives.

fields.htmlDescription: Aki Abramowski is a highly driven and independent Software Engineer at Search Guard.
fields.shortDescription: Aki Abramowski is a highly driven and independent Software Engineer with over five years of work experience. Aki has substantial expertise in Java backend programming, Elasticsearch, and Search Guard. As a fast learner, Aki is always eager to explore and master modern software technologies.
fields.biography: Aki has been with Search Guard for the last five years. He started his time with us as an intern before working both full time and part time alongside his studies. Aki will complete his Bachelor of Science at the Leibniz University in Hannover next September.
